text:
elaine: @here PulseTech asked to onboard lyrebird-30B for customer-facing summarization. They need p99 < 200ms on 256 tokens and cost target <= $0.0008/token. Artifacts: s3 link incoming.
rohan: Do we have the weights and tokenizer? who submitted upstream? HF repo or private tarball?
customer_ops: NDA signed. Artifacts on S3: s3://pulse-models/lyrebird-30b/v1/lyrebird_v1.tar.gz. Contact: jon_p@pulsetech. We'll share creds via ops.
elaine: Priority: medium-high. Use case: web UI summaries, soft SLA for latency. Also must pass safety scans.
sam_k: I'll start a quant smoke (fp16 -> 4-bit). Need a baseline eval set. Anyone owns summarization eval suite?
rohan: Olivia maintains summarization evals. @olivia can you run ROUGE/BERTScore + hallucination checks? Also run safety filter tests.
olivia: Yep. I'll stage an eval bundle at /evals/summarization/lyrebird/2026-03-19. Metrics: ROUGE-1/2/L, BERTScore, hallucination-rate, and latency p50/p95/p99 on G4dn and A10G.
quant-bot: Auto-queue created: quant-jobs/1739992222-lyrebird-smoke. ETA ~2h. Logs: /var/log/quant/1739992222.log
sam_k: Quick starter commands:
```
python tools/quantize.py \
  --model s3://pulse-models/lyrebird-30b/v1 \
  --format gguf --bits 4 --out /mnt/tmp/lyrebird-4bit.gguf
```
Also checklist before heavy runs: 1) confirm tokenizer & vocab match repo 2) run 10-sample functional regression 3) check kv-cache memory 4) collect baseline latency.
elaine: Canary plan: route 5% traffic to quantized variant. Watch metrics: latency, ROUGE, error_rate. If ROUGE drops > 1.5 pts or error_rate > 0.5% rollback immediately.
rohan: I'll provision 1x A10G staging node: tag lyrebird-30b-staging-qa. @infra please expedite.
infra-bot: Provision request accepted (INF-8923). Staging ready in ~40m.
customer_ops: Jon@PulseTech ok with canary and requests a 2-week observation window.
olivia: I'll run FP16 baseline by EOD and 4-bit NGQA smoke by tomorrow noon, will post results here.
elaine: :thumbsup: Thanks team — keep updates short here, ping me for blockers.
